remarks:
This scenic property is drawing attention from buyers looking to build a year-round investment in the heart of ski country. Located just minutes from two major ski resorts and the always-popular village of Ellicottville, it offers the perfect blend of natural beauty and prime access to four-season fun. Set in a peaceful, wooded environment, it’s an ideal spot to construct a custom cabin, chalet, or even a trendy barndominium—two of which have already been recently built nearby. With inspiration readily available through platforms like Facebook and Pinterest, finding the perfect design is just a tap away.

Situated in the increasingly popular Dublin area, this location offers both tranquility and proximity to adventure. Whether you're looking to create a personal getaway or a smart investment property, this is the kind of land that makes sense now—and will only grow in value over time. Don’t miss the opportunity to stake your claim in one of Western New York’s most promising up-and-coming locations. Priced below market value! Owner is very motivated to sell!
